code:
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "origin", "main"],
    cwd="/srv/northbridge/app",
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
)

print(result.stdout, result.returncode)
caption: run() returns stdout, stderr, and a returncode to check.
0 means success; anything else means the command failed.

code:
# Safer: list of args, no shell involved
subprocess.run(["ls", "-la", "/var/log/northbridge"])

# Risky: a string handed to the shell
subprocess.run(f"ls -la /var/log/{server}", shell=True)
caption: shell=True can let unsanitized input run extra commands.
